about_the_game:
Defend Your Castle, Push Your Limits!

Pixelate Tower Defense is a carefully crafted pixel-art tower defense combining endless challenges with multiplayer battles.

🎮 Two Core Modes

Single Player - Endless ChallengeInfinite waves test your limits! Enemies grow stronger—how far can you go? Face powerful Bosses

every 5 waves and choose upgrade cards to strengthen your defenses.

VS Mode - Real-Time PvP10-wave showdown! Battle players in real-time, using the mercenary system to attack opponents while

defending your own castle.

🗼 5 Tower Types

- Basic Tower - Cost-effective defense

- Sniper Tower - Ultra-long range

- Cannon Tower - Area explosion

- Ice Tower - Slowing control

- Lightning Tower - Chain attacks

👾 7 Enemy Types + BOSS

From normal troops to tanks, from hounds to wagons—each enemy requires different strategies. The Boss appearing every 5 waves

has 50x HP and deals massive damage!

🎴 Card Upgrade System

Choose reward cards after each wave: boost gold, strengthen castle, upgrade tower stats, or enhance mercenaries (VS mode). Every

choice shapes your strategy!

✨ Features

- 🗺️ Procedurally generated maps, unique every game

- 🌍 Multi-language support (CN/EN/JP)

- 🎵 Complete sound system

- 📱 Cross-platform support

- ⚡ Smooth gameplay experience

How many waves can you survive in single player? Can you dominate in VS mode? Challenge yourself now!

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 LTS or SteamOS 3 or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or AMD Ryzen 3 or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GPU supporting OpenGL 2.1 or Vulkan
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any standard onboard sound card
  • VR Support: N/A
  • Additional Notes: Distributed as an AppImage. No installation required.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 12 Monterey or later
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core i3 (Universal build)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated or dedicated GPU supporting Metal or OpenGL 2.1
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any standard onboard sound card
  • Additional Notes: Compatible with both Apple Silicon and Intel Macs. Best experienced with mouse and keyboard.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit) or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or AMD Ryzen 3 or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated or dedicated GPU supporting OpenGL 2.1 or DirectX 11
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any standard onboard sound card
  • VR Support: N/A
  • Additional Notes: Recommended to play at 1080p with mouse and keyboard.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
